document_title: Process Characterization Report — Protein A Chromatography (Step 5)
schema_note: Blocks validate against nlp_reports app/models; parameter_type, document_type, QualityAttribute criticality fields, StudyDesign and DesignSpace are local extensions (see schema_extensions_used).
schema_extensions_used: RevisionEntry / GroundTruthAnnex.supersedes (new) — the revision layer, anchored on the rendered revision-history rows
AcceptanceCriterionRecord (new) — step acceptance criteria tagged with the revision that applied them and whether they are in force or superseded
ProvenAcceptableRange (new model) — per output x parameter PAR at set-point and NOR-propagated, from doe_report.par_table
RhetoricalSpan (new model) — argument-structure roles over the report prose
out_of_schema_notes: ProvenAcceptableRange keeps the field name par_at_setpoint although the value is computed with the other factors at the design centre (registered discrepancy D-001). For this step the set-point of every design factor is the centre of its range studied.
The leached Protein A and fragment PAR rows come from models that are not adequate; the report claims no PAR from them, and their acceptance_basis says so.

The hold study S-PA-HLD and the nrCE-SDS retest S-PA-RET have no StudyDesign.study_type and have no study record; the hold result is a report statement. S-PA-SDM2 (DEV-005-03) is a scale_down_qualification record.

The scale-down qualification table, the univariate result tables, the residual checks, the centre-point tables, the screening and coefficient tables other than those cited by assertions, the hold table and the design matrices are not represented row by row.
The Cpk of leached Protein A is recorded as printed; the report states it is not meaningful because the simulated values lie below the limit of quantitation.
Step yield is a performance attribute with no criterion (concept attr:step_yield).
rhetorical_spans re-curated against the Version 2.0 text (authoring/rhetorical/PCR-005.spans.yaml). weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: The capture step of the purification train, operated in bind and elute mode. It removes most of the host cell protein and DNA of the clarified harvest, partly clears fragments, and adds leached Protein A ligand. The eluate passes to low-pH viral inactivation (Step 6) without neutralization.
output_materials: Protein A eluate at elution pH (low-pH viral inactivation load)
equipment: laboratory column packed with the commercial Protein A resin

source_references.quote: Protein A chromatography is the capture step of the purification train.

design_spaces.definition: The region in protein load and elution buffer pH, the two WC-CPPs, over which pool host cell protein meets its intermediate acceptance criterion. Leached Protein A and fragments met their criteria in every run and step yield has no criterion, so they do not constrain it. The excluded region is the corner of high protein load and low elution buffer pH; the claim is made through the NOR-propagated PARs.

statements.statement_text: Version 2.0 re-analyses the experiments of Version 1.0 against the criteria of PCMP-001 Version 2.0, issued under INV-001, and adds fragments by nrCE-SDS.

source_references.quote: It re-analyses the same experiments as Version 1.0 against the criteria of PCMP-001 Version 2.0, issued under INV-001, and adds the fragment results by nrCE-SDS.

statements.statement_text: Protein load and elution buffer pH are WC-CPPs, load flow rate and end of pool collect KPPs, and operating temperature and bed height GPPs; the step has no CPP.

source_references.quote: No parameter of the step was classified as a CPP.

statements.statement_text: With the planned set-point runs the scale-down model could not demonstrate equivalence whatever the means were (DEV-005-03); supplementary runs were made with the margins unchanged.

source_references.quote: The planned set-point runs could not demonstrate equivalence whatever the means were

statements.statement_text: Leached Protein A is consistently lower in the scale-down model, an expected scale effect from the longer hold of the manufacturing load before capture, which this study does not test; the difference was accepted.

source_references.quote: Its expected cause is the longer hold of the clarified harvest before capture at manufacturing scale, which gives host cell proteases more time to cleave ligand from the resin.

statements.statement_text: The scale-down model was not shown equivalent for step yield, so the step yield model is not used for any range or prediction, and the KPP classes rest on the direction of the yield effects.

source_references.quote: The KPP classes of load flow rate and end of pool collect rest on the direction of the yield effects, which both designs show, and not on the model

statements.statement_text: Pool host cell protein rises with protein load and as elution buffer pH falls, the two interact, and it falls as end of pool collect is extended.

source_references.quote: Pool host cell protein rises with protein load and as elution buffer pH falls, and the two parameters interact.

statements.statement_text: The full quadratic model for step yield failed the predictive criterion and was replaced by a reduced model with the terms significant in both designs.

source_references.quote: The full quadratic model fails the predictive criterion, and a reduced model with the terms significant in both designs meets criteria 2 to 4 of PCP-005 §7.

statements.statement_text: No response-surface model meets criterion 5; the conclusions on pool host cell protein rest on an influence analysis, a departure from the plan.

source_references.quote: The analysis departed from the plan in one place.

statements.statement_text: The effect of end of pool collect on pool host cell protein and its interactions have opposite signs in the two designs, for a reason that was not identified.

source_references.quote: The difference is larger than the noise of the screening design, and its cause was not identified

statements.statement_text: Load flow rate did not raise pool host cell protein as the mechanism predicts.

source_references.quote: Load flow rate did not raise pool host cell protein as the mechanism predicts.

statements.statement_text: Every output met its intermediate acceptance criterion across the NOR, and the NOR-propagated PAR of elution buffer pH for pool host cell protein is the only one narrower than its range studied.

source_references.quote: the only one whose NOR-propagated PAR is narrower than its range studied

statements.statement_text: The Protein A eluate may be held at elution pH for the full hold studied at both temperatures; fragments rose at both, with no temperature dependence shown.

source_references.section_title: Hold study of the Protein A eluate
heading_path: Hold study of the Protein A eluate
source_references.quote: so the data do not show that fragmentation depends on temperature

statements.statement_text: No difference from the set-point runs was detected at either end of the ranges of operating temperature and bed height, and with two runs at each end the intervals are wide.

source_references.quote: With two runs at each end the intervals are wide, so the study excludes only effects larger than their upper bounds.

statements.statement_text: The Version 2.0 criterion for pool host cell protein is wider than the Version 1.0 limit, which was never approved and is replaced by a criterion derived without data from the studies it judges.

source_references.quote: The Version 1.0 limit was never approved and appears in no approved plan, and it is replaced by a criterion derived without data from the studies it judges.

statements.statement_text: The step yield effects describe the scale-down model; their size at manufacturing scale is not established.

source_references.quote: Their direction, which both designs show, supports the KPP classes in

statements.statement_text: In the NOR-propagated analysis the model coefficients are drawn from their estimated covariance in every simulated run, together with the residual.

source_references.quote: In the NOR-propagated analysis the model coefficients are drawn from their estimated covariance in every simulated run, together with the residual.

source_reference.quote: The design space of this step is the region in protein load and elution buffer pH, the two WC-CPPs, over which pool host cell protein meets its intermediate acceptance criterion.
The excluded region is the corner of high protein load and low elution buffer pH
No adequate model results for leached Protein A, so its dependence on the parameters of the multivariate design is not resolved.
It shows only that any dependence is too small to resolve against the variation of the runs.
These figures describe the drug substance after cation exchange and anion exchange have removed most of what the Protein A pool carries.
The results roll up into the Process Characterization Master Report PCMR-001.

Leached Protein A comes from hydrolysis of the coupling chemistry and from cleavage of exposed ligand by host cell proteases in the load, and the leached fragments elute with the antibody because they still bind Fc.
More protease activity in the load, for example after a longer hold of the clarified harvest before capture, is expected to cleave more ligand.
Resin use, cleaning and sanitization are controlled by SOP-2008, and the hold of the clarified harvest is characterized in PCR-004.
Under criterion 1 of PCP-005 §7 the step yield model is therefore not used for any range or prediction.
Where no adequate model resulted, the response is reported descriptively against its criterion over the runs of the design.
